The listed cement maker that also holds ownership of Thatta Power (Private) Limited disclosed the development via a notice to the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) on Thursday. “Thatta Cement Company Limited has reached an in-principle understanding regarding the proposed restructuring of Pakistan Services Limited, subject to finalisation of definitive agreement(s), which will be duly communicated to the Exchange in due course,” said the company. title: UBS says its China fund distribution unit will cease business
summary: HONG KONG/SHANGHAI: UBS said on Thursday its China fund distribution unit in the tech hunb of Shenzhen would cease fund sales business from the end of September.
